newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal forms new auto products group.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal forms new auto products group.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said it is forming a new business, an Automotive Products Group, to serve aftermarket customers and original equipment manufacturers.
AlliedSignal said Monday it would create the group by combining its Aftermarket North America, Aftermarket Europe, Prestone, Friction Materials, Filters and Spark Plugs and its Asian operations.
Greg Summe, currently president of the Engines business at AlliedSignal Aerospace, will become president of the Automotive Products Group, AlliedSignal said.

AlliedSignal said the goal is to improve customer focus and increase growth by managing business globally and by creating a more seamless alignment of sales and marketing with manufacturing and engineering.
